target_customer: LatAm companies, starting with Colombian startups and SMEs, that move recurring high volume money (payouts, wallets, cards)
problem: Opening business bank accounts and moving money in Colombia was slow and hard for startups; Mono started as a business account and became embedded finance infrastructure.
business_model: API-first embedded finance: fees on payins, payouts, card and wallet usage

founders.name: Salomon Zarruk
founders.background_notes: Forbes Colombia: lawyer who previously founded SMEs in Colombia, Chile and Mexico. TechCrunch says he and Ortiz worked together at Tpaga then launched its mobile wallet in Mexico.

founders.name: Juan Camilo Poveda
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch: developed lending and banking products at Nubank. YC lists him as CEO.

founders.name: Jose Tomas Lobo
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch: tech operations and execution background; named as COO by Forbes Colombia.

technical_complexity.rationale: Banking partner integration, cards and payments in Colombia with regulatory constraints; a small team shipped it in 2020 to 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Integrated payment rails and Bre-B participation create switching costs, but features are replicable by other payment APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Mono later partnered with Bancoomeva and joined Bre-B (2025).

market_need_then: TechCrunch (June 2022): founders describe the pain of opening business accounts; 300 customers and $1M payment volume by March 2022.

branding.name_origin: Founders say they liked the jungle wordplay: startups are like surviving the jungle and a monkey (mono) is weak alone but strong in a group (La Republica, via search summary).

identity.mascot_or_character: Monkey with glasses mascot on website

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable name and mascot on site, but little independent press on the brand.

pivots.from: Business bank account and debit card for startups
pivots.to: Embedded finance infrastructure (wallets, payouts, cards) for LatAm enterprises
pivots.why: Not stated; observed from product pages

outcome_analysis: Mono is active with about 30 people. It raised a $6M seed from Tiger Global in 2022 and later repositioned from SME banking to infrastructure, joining Bre-B in 2025 and claiming over $2B processed. The CEO changed from Zarruk to Poveda. Later rounds were not verified, so the funding picture is partial.
notes: Seedtable lists a $15M Series A on 2021-10-11 and Dealroom/Tracxn give valuations of $24M and $50M; single aggregator sources, unverified and not recorded. The pre-seed $1.5M is from Forbes Colombia January 2022 with no stated date. Competitors: TechCrunch says rivals focus on business cards, terminals or cash management but names none, so the list is empty. Education not found.
